title: 第 27 章 五雷道法大圆满境界
novel_title: 我被师姐凌辱，你说我罪恶滔天？
content_zh:
“首座弟子有话要说。”

    林凤瑶从人群中走了出来，她抬起头看着高台上的鹤阳真人脸上带着几分不满。

    “凤瑶你有什么话尽管说。”鹤阳真人开口道。

    “陆云服用爆元丹强行提升修为，这已经违反了宗门大典的规矩。”林凤瑶说道。

    “弟子恳请首座制止这场比试，取消陆云的参赛资格。”

    当大长老听到这话之后脸色一沉，他在心里想着这个林凤瑶怎么又跳出来坏事。

    “林凤瑶你懂什么。”大长老冷声道。

    “爆元丹是陆云自己的丹药，服用与否是他的自由何来违反规矩一说。”

    “宗门大典的规矩是公平比试不得借助外物。”林凤瑶说道。

    “爆元丹强行提升修为这跟作弊有什么区别。”

    “你……”大长老被噎了一下脸色更加难看。

    “陆云是我大长老的弟子，他行事光明磊落何来作弊一说。”

    “反倒是你说的那个陈默，他用的那件法器难道就不是外物了吗。”

    “他用得陆云就用不得这是什么道理。”

    这时林凤瑶还想说什么可话到嘴边又咽了回去，她在心里想着大长老这是在强词夺理。

    可大长老的地位摆在那里她一个弟子也不好跟他硬顶。

    只见鹤阳真人坐在主位上眉头紧锁，他在心里想着这场比试确实该制止了。

    毕竟陆云服用了爆元丹强行提升到元婴期，陈默不过金丹五层的修为根本不可能是对手。

    再打下去陈默非死即伤，到时候他这个首座也不好交代。

    正当鹤阳真人准备开口叫停比试，忽然他的目光停住了。

    广场的入口处走来了两个人，前面的是一个身穿白色长裙的女子容貌极美气质清冷高贵。

    只见她的身后还跟着一个侍女，正是苏婉清身边的那个。

    “是内门的沈长老。”

    “她怎么来了，之前宗门大典从来没见过内门的长老来过。”

    “旁边那个不是苏婉清师姐的侍女吗，难道苏师姐也来了。”

    台下的弟子们纷纷转过头看向入口处，他们的脸上都带着惊讶的表情。

    当鹤阳真人看到来人之后立刻站了起来，他走下高台迎了上去脸上带着笑容。

    “沈长老光临我外门宗门大典，老夫有失远迎还望恕罪。”鹤阳真人拱手道。

    “鹤阳首座客气了。”沈长老淡淡道。
content_en:
"The first disciple has something to say."

    Lin Fengyao walked out from the crowd. She raised her head and looked at Master Heyang on the high platform with a bit of dissatisfaction on his face.

    "Feng Yao, if you have anything to say, just say it." Master Heyang said.

    "Lu Yun took Baoyuan Dan to forcibly improve his cultivation. This has violated the rules of the sect's ceremony." Lin Fengyao said.

    "Disciple, please beg the leader to stop this competition and disqualify Lu Yun from participating."

    When the great elder heard this, his face darkened, and he was thinking in his mind why this Lin Fengyao did something bad again.

    "Lin Fengyao, what do you know?" the elder said coldly.

    "The Baoyuan Pill is Lu Yun's own pill. Whether he takes it or not is his freedom. How can he violate the rules?"

    "The rules of the sect's grand ceremony are that no foreign objects can be used in a fair competition." Lin Fengyao said.

    "What's the difference between using the Exploding Yuan Dan to forcibly improve your cultivation level and cheating?"

    "You..." The great elder was choked and his face became even more ugly.

    "Lu Yun is my great elder's disciple. He acts aboveboard, so how can he cheat?"

    "On the contrary, it's the Chen Mo you're talking about. Isn't the magic weapon he used a foreign object?"

    "He can use Lu Yun but he can't use it. What's the point?"

    At this time, Lin Fengyao wanted to say something, but she swallowed it back. She thought in her heart that the elder was using strong words.

    But given the great elder's status, it was not easy for any of her disciples to compete with him.

    I saw Master Heyang sitting in the main seat with a frown on his face. He thought in his heart that this competition should really be stopped.

    After all, Lu Yun took the Explosive Yuan Pill and was forcibly promoted to the Nascent Soul Stage. Chen Mo, who was only at the fifth level of the Golden Pill, couldn't possibly be his opponent.

    If the fight continues, Chen Mo will either die or be injured, and it will be difficult for him to be the leader by then.

    Just as Master Heyang was about to stop the competition, his eyes suddenly stopped.

    Two people came to the entrance of the square. In front of them was a woman in a white dress with a very beautiful appearance, a cold and noble temperament.

    There was a maid behind her, the one beside Su Wanqing.

    "It's Elder Shen from the inner sect."

    "Why is she here? I have never seen the elders of the inner sect come before the sect's grand ceremony."

    "Isn't that the maid next to Senior Sister Su Wanqing? Could it be that Senior Sister Su is here too."

    The disciples in the audience turned their heads to look at the entrance, with expressions of surprise on their faces.

    When Master Heyang saw the person coming, he immediately stood up, walked down the platform and greeted him with a smile on his face.

    "Elder Shen is here to attend the grand ceremony of our outer sect. I feel sorry for you that I feel sorry for you." Master Heyang cupped his hands and said.

    "You're welcome, Chief Heyang." Elder Shen said calmly.
